verdict.rationale: Postman supports bulk operations via running entire collections (many requests at once) through Postman CLI/Newman, scripting pre/post-request logic across requests, and programmatic access via the Postman API to manage assets in bulk, plus CI/CD integration for batch runs. However, there's no explicit documentation of AI-native bulk operations (e.g., an agent issuing a single command to modify/delete/update many items at once beyond running a collection), and no hands-on evidence validating this at scale for large item sets. missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-driven bulk edit/update workflows across many items, independent hands-on validation of bulk operation performance/reliability at scale.
